entries.name: Cable Wrist Curl
entries.reason: Source-bound side-view draft with a hand that bends at the wrist. Sitting on a bench facing a low pulley, forearms level along the thighs and the wrists just past the knees; only the hands move, curling the bar up from extended wrists, pausing, and lowering slowly. The pulley sits below the line of the dropped hands, so the cable only lengthens as the wrists curl. Not drawn: the shoulder-width grip, which a side view cannot show, and a close-up of the hand, which the catalogue asks for; this frame shows the whole seated figure.
entries.summary: Seated facing a low pulley with the forearms on the thighs, curl the wrists up as far as they go, pause, then lower the bar slowly until the wrists are extended again.

frames.caption: Sit on a bench facing a low pulley, grip the bar palms-up and rest the forearms on the thighs with the wrists just past the knees.
Keeping the forearms still, curl the wrists up as far as they go.
Lower the bar slowly until the wrists are extended again.
Forearms stay on the thighs. Only the wrists move.
